data.name: es.subtitle
data.value: System-wide email behavior: default addresses and templates, incoming mail processing and the outgoing mail method.

data.name: es.defaultTemplateHelp
data.value: All emails use these templates unless the department selects a different set.

data.name: es.defaultEmailHelp
data.value: Address used when no other address is specified on outgoing email.

data.name: es.alertEmailHelp
data.value: The sender address for alerts and notifications sent to agents.

data.name: es.adminEmailHelp
data.value: System errors and critical alerts are sent to this address.

data.name: es.verifyDomainHelp
data.value: The domain's MX record is checked when email addresses are saved.

data.name: es.pollingHelp
data.value: The system regularly pulls new email from the configured mailboxes.

data.name: es.cronHelp
data.value: Fetching is triggered by the server scheduler; when off, only page visits trigger it.

data.name: es.stripQuotedHelp
data.value: Quoted older correspondence in reply emails is not added to the ticket.

data.name: es.separatorHelp
data.value: Everything below this line is trimmed from the email.

data.name: es.emailPriorityHelp
data.value: The priority flagged by the sender (e.g. "high importance") is applied to the ticket.

data.name: es.acceptUnregisteredHelp
data.value: Emails from addresses not registered in the system can also open tickets.

data.name: es.autoCollabsHelp
data.value: Addresses on the email's CC line are added to the ticket as collaborators.

data.name: es.defaultSmtpHelp
data.value: Email from addresses without their own SMTP settings is sent this way.

data.name: es.attachmentsHelp
data.value: File attachments are included in outgoing email; when off, only a link is sent.

data.name: es.errAdminEmail
data.value: The admin email must be a valid address.
